verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς οἱ δυνατοὶ Ὀφείλομεν βαστάζειν τὰ ἀσθενήματα τῶν ἀδυνάτων καὶ μὴ ἀρέσκειν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis hoi dynatoi Opheilomen bastazein ta asthenēmata tōn adynatōn kai mē areskein heautois
verses.literal: - We who [are] strong ought to bear with the shortcomings of the weak and not to please ourselves

verses.original: ἕκαστος ἡμῶν ἀρεσκέτω τῷ πλησίον εἰς τὸ ἀγαθὸν πρὸς οἰκοδομήν
verses.transliteration: hekastos hēmōn aresketō tō plēsion eis to agathon pros oikodomēn
verses.literal: Each of us should please [his] neighbor for [his] good to build [him] up

verses.original: γὰρ καὶ ὁ Χριστὸς οὐχ ἤρεσεν ἑαυτῷ ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται Οἱ ὀνειδισμοὶ τῶν ὀνειδιζόντων σε ἐπέπεσαν ἐπ’ ἐμέ
verses.transliteration: gar kai ho Christos ouch ēresen heautō alla kathōs gegraptai Hoi oneidismoi tōn oneidizontōn se epepesan ep’ eme
verses.literal: For even - Christ {did} not please Himself but as it is written The insults of those who insult You have fallen on Me

verses.original: γὰρ ὅσα πάντα προεγράφη ἐγράφη εἰς ἡμετέραν τὴν διδασκαλίαν ἵνα διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ διὰ τῆς παρακλήσεως τῶν γραφῶν ἔχωμεν τὴν ἐλπίδα
verses.transliteration: gar hosa panta proegraphē egraphē eis hēmeteran tēn didaskalian hina dia tēs hypomonēs kai dia tēs paraklēseōs tōn graphōn echōmen tēn elpida
verses.literal: For everything that . . . was written in the past was written for our - instruction so that through - endurance and - the encouragement of the Scriptures we might have - hope

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ὑπομονῆς καὶ τῆς παρακλήσεως δῴη ὑμῖν τὸ αὐτὸ φρονεῖν ἐν ἀλλήλοις κατὰ Χριστὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: de Ho Theos tēs hypomonēs kai tēs paraklēseōs dōē hymin to auto phronein en allēlois kata Christon Iēsoun
verses.literal: Now {may} the God - [who gives] endurance and - encouragement grant you vvv vvv harmony with one another in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ἵνα ὁμοθυμαδὸν ἐν ἑνὶ στόματι δοξάζητε τὸν Θεὸν καὶ Πατέρα ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hina homothymadon en heni stomati doxazēte ton Theon kai Patera hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: so that with one mind [and] one voice you may glorify the God and Father of our - Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: προσλαμβάνεσθε ἀλλήλους Διὸ καὶ καθὼς ὁ Χριστὸς προσελάβετο ὑμᾶς εἰς δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: proslambanesthe allēlous Dio kai kathōs ho Christos proselabeto hymas eis doxan tou Theou
verses.literal: Accept one another then just as - Christ accepted you in order to bring glory - to God

verses.original: γὰρ λέγω Χριστὸν γεγενῆσθαι διάκονον περιτομῆς ὑπὲρ Θεοῦ ἀληθείας εἰς τὸ βεβαιῶσαι τὰς ἐπαγγελίας τῶν πατέρων
verses.transliteration: gar legō Christon gegenēsthai diakonon peritomēs hyper Theou alētheias eis to bebaiōsai tas epangelias tōn paterōn
verses.literal: For I tell [you that] Christ has become a servant of [the] circumcised on behalf of God’s truth to - confirm the promises made to the patriarchs

verses.original: δὲ τὰ ἔθνη δοξάσαι τὸν Θεόν ὑπὲρ ἐλέους καθὼς γέγραπται Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι ἐν ἔθνεσιν καὶ ψαλῶ τῷ σου ὀνόματί
verses.transliteration: de ta ethnē doxasai ton Theon hyper eleous kathōs gegraptai Dia touto exomologēsomai soi en ethnesin kai psalō tō sou onomati
verses.literal: [so that] the Gentiles may glorify - God for [His] mercy As it is written Therefore . . . I will praise You among [the] Gentiles - I will sing hymns to Your name

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν λέγει Εὐφράνθητε ἔθνη μετὰ αὐτοῦ τοῦ λαοῦ
verses.transliteration: Kai palin legei Euphranthēte ethnē meta autou tou laou
verses.literal: - Again it says Rejoice O Gentiles with His - people

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν Αἰνεῖτε τὸν Κύριον πάντα τὰ ἔθνη καὶ ἐπαινεσάτωσαν αὐτὸν πάντες οἱ λαοί
verses.transliteration: Kai palin Aineite ton Kyrion panta ta ethnē kai epainesatōsan auton pantes hoi laoi
verses.literal: And again Praise the Lord all [you] Gentiles and extol Him all [you] peoples

verses.original: Καὶ πάλιν Ἠσαΐας λέγει ἡ ῥίζα τοῦ Ἰεσσαί Ἔσται καὶ ὁ ἀνιστάμενος ἄρχειν ἐθνῶν ἐπ’ αὐτῷ ἔθνη ἐλπιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai palin Ēsaias legei hē rhiza tou Iessai Estai kai ho anistamenos archein ethnōn ep’ autō ethnē elpiousin
verses.literal: And once more Isaiah says The Root - of Jesse will appear - [One who] will arise to rule over [the] Gentiles in Him [the] Gentiles will put their hope

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς ἐλπίδος πληρώσαι ὑμᾶς πάσης χαρᾶς καὶ εἰρήνης ἐν τῷ πιστεύειν εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ περισσεύειν ἐν τῇ ἐλπίδι ἐν δυνάμει Ἁγίου Πνεύματος
verses.transliteration: de Ho Theos tēs elpidos plērōsai hymas pasēs charas kai eirēnēs en tō pisteuein eis hymas to perisseuein en tē elpidi en dynamei Hagiou Pneumatos
verses.literal: Now {may} the God - of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you - believe [in Him] so that you - may overflow with - hope by [the] power [of the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: δέ καὶ ἐγὼ αὐτὸς Πέπεισμαι περὶ ὑμῶν μου ἀδελφοί ὅτι αὐτοὶ καὶ ἐστε μεστοί ἀγαθωσύνης πεπληρωμένοι πάσης τῆς γνώσεως καὶ δυνάμενοι νουθετεῖν ἀλλήλους
verses.transliteration: de kai egō autos Pepeismai peri hymōn mou adelphoi hoti autoi kai este mestoi agathōsynēs peplērōmenoi pasēs tēs gnōseōs kai dynamenoi nouthetein allēlous
verses.literal: - - I myself am convinced - - my brothers that you yourselves - are full of goodness brimming with - knowledge and able to instruct one another

verses.original: δὲ ἔγραψα ὑμῖν τολμηρότερον ὡς ἐπαναμιμνήσκων ὑμᾶς ἀπὸ μέρους διὰ τὴν χάριν ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι
verses.transliteration: de egrapsa hymin tolmēroteron hōs epanamimnēskōn hymas apo merous dia tēn charin hypo tou Theou tēn dotheisan moi
verses.literal: However I have written you a bold vvv reminder - on some points because of the grace - - God - has given me

verses.original: εἰς τὸ με εἶναί λειτουργὸν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ εἰς τὰ ἔθνη ἱερουργοῦντα τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἵνα τῶν ἐθνῶν γένηται ἡ προσφορὰ εὐπρόσδεκτος ἡγιασμένη ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: eis to me einai leitourgon Christou Iēsou eis ta ethnē hierourgounta to euangelion tou Theou hina tōn ethnōn genētai hē prosphora euprosdektos hēgiasmenē en Hagiō Pneumati
verses.literal: - - - to be a minister of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles in the priestly service of the gospel - of God so that the Gentiles might become - [an] offering acceptable [to God] sanctified by [the] Holy Spirit

verses.original: οὖν Ἔχω τὴν καύχησιν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ τὰ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: oun Echō tēn kauchēsin en Christō Iēsou ta pros ton Theon
verses.literal: Therefore vvv vvv I exult in Christ Jesus in [ my service ] to - God

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ τολμήσω λαλεῖν τι οὐ ὧν Χριστὸς κατειργάσατο δι’ ἐμοῦ εἰς ἐθνῶν ὑπακοὴν λόγῳ καὶ ἔργῳ
verses.transliteration: gar ou tolmēsō lalein ti ou hōn Christos kateirgasato di’ emou eis ethnōn hypakoēn logō kai ergō
verses.literal: - vvv I will not presume to speak of anything except what Christ has accomplished through me in leading [the] Gentiles to obedience by word and deed

verses.original: ἐν δυνάμει σημείων καὶ τεράτων ἐν δυνάμει Πνεύματος θεοῦ ὥστε ἀπὸ Ἰερουσαλὴμ καὶ κύκλῳ μέχρι τοῦ Ἰλλυρικοῦ με πεπληρωκέναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: en dynamei sēmeiōn kai teratōn en dynamei Pneumatos theou hōste apo Ierousalēm kai kyklō mechri tou Illyrikou me peplērōkenai to euangelion tou Christou
verses.literal: by [the] power of signs and wonders [and] by [the] power of [the] Spirit of God So from Jerusalem all the way around to - Illyricum I have fully proclaimed the gospel - of Christ

verses.original: δὲ οὕτως φιλοτιμούμενον εὐαγγελίζεσθαι ὅπου Χριστός οὐχ ὠνομάσθη ἵνα μὴ οἰκοδομῶ ἐπ’ ἀλλότριον θεμέλιον
verses.transliteration: de houtōs philotimoumenon euangelizesthai hopou Christos ouch ōnomasthē hina mē oikodomō ep’ allotrion themelion
verses.literal: - In this way I have aspired to preach the gospel where Christ vvv was not known so that vvv I would not be building on someone [else’s] foundation

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καθὼς γέγραπται οἷς οὐκ ἀνηγγέλη περὶ αὐτοῦ Ὄψονται καὶ οἳ οὐκ ἀκηκόασιν συνήσουσιν
verses.transliteration: alla kathōs gegraptai hois ouk anēngelē peri autou Opsontai kai hoi ouk akēkoasin synēsousin
verses.literal: Rather as it is written Those who vvv were not told about Him will see and those who vvv have not heard will understand

verses.original: Διὸ καὶ ἐνεκοπτόμην τὰ πολλὰ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Dio kai enekoptomēn ta polla tou elthein pros hymas
verses.literal: That is why - I have often been hindered . . . . . . - from coming to you

verses.original: δὲ Νυνὶ μηκέτι τόπον ἔχων ἐν τούτοις τοῖς κλίμασι δὲ ἔχων ἐπιποθίαν ἀπὸ ἱκανῶν ἐτῶν τοῦ ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: de Nyni mēketi topon echōn en toutois tois klimasi de echōn epipothian apo hikanōn etōn tou elthein pros hymas
verses.literal: But now that [there are] no further opportunities for me in these - regions and since I have longed for many years - to visit . . . you

verses.original: ἐλπίζω γὰρ θεάσασθαι ὑμᾶς διαπορευόμενος ὡς ἂν πορεύωμαι εἰς τὴν Σπανίαν καὶ ἐὰν πρῶτον ἐμπλησθῶ ὑμῶν ἀπὸ μέρους προπεμφθῆναι ὑφ’ ὑμῶν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: elpizō gar theasasthai hymas diaporeuomenos hōs an poreuōmai eis tēn Spanian kai ean prōton emplēsthō hymōn apo merous propemphthēnai hyph’ hymōn ekei
verses.literal: I hope - to see you - on . . . my way to - Spain And [after] . . . I have enjoyed your company . . . for a while you can equip me . . . . . . [for my journey]

verses.original: Νυνὶ δὲ πορεύομαι εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ διακονῶν τοῖς ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: Nyni de poreuomai eis Ierousalēm diakonōn tois hagiois
verses.literal: Now however I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints [there]

verses.original: γὰρ Μακεδονία καὶ Ἀχαΐα εὐδόκησαν ποιήσασθαι τινὰ κοινωνίαν εἰς τοὺς πτωχοὺς τῶν ἁγίων τῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλήμ
verses.transliteration: gar Makedonia kai Achaia eudokēsan poiēsasthai tina koinōnian eis tous ptōchous tōn hagiōn tōn en Ierousalēm
verses.literal: For Macedonia and Achaia were pleased to make a contribution for the poor among the saints - in Jerusalem

verses.original: εὐδόκησαν καὶ γάρ εἰσὶν ὀφειλέται αὐτῶν γὰρ εἰ τὰ ἔθνη ἐκοινώνησαν αὐτῶν πνευματικοῖς τοῖς ὀφείλουσιν καὶ λειτουργῆσαι αὐτοῖς ἐν τοῖς σαρκικοῖς
verses.transliteration: eudokēsan kai gar eisin opheiletai autōn gar ei ta ethnē ekoinōnēsan autōn pneumatikois tois opheilousin kai leitourgēsai autois en tois sarkikois
verses.literal: They were pleased [to do it] and indeed they owe it to them For if the Gentiles have shared in their spiritual [blessings] they are obligated . . . to minister to them with - material [blessings]

verses.original: οὖν ἐπιτελέσας Τοῦτο καὶ σφραγισάμενος τοῦτον τὸν καρπὸν αὐτοῖς ἀπελεύσομαι εἰς Σπανίαν δι’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: oun epitelesas Touto kai sphragisamenos touton ton karpon autois apeleusomai eis Spanian di’ hymōn
verses.literal: So after I have completed this [service] and have safely delivered this - bounty to them I will set off to Spain by way of you

verses.original: δὲ οἶδα ὅτι ἐρχόμενος πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐλεύσομαι ἐν πληρώματι εὐλογίας Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: de oida hoti erchomenos pros hymas eleusomai en plērōmati eulogias Christou
verses.literal: - I know that when I come to you I will come in [the] fullness of the blessing of Christ

verses.original: δὲ Παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ καὶ διὰ τῆς ἀγάπης τοῦ Πνεύματος συναγωνίσασθαί μοι ἐν ταῖς προσευχαῖς πρὸς τὸν Θεόν ὑπὲρ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: de Parakalō hymas adelphoi dia hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou Christou kai dia tēs agapēs tou Pneumatos synagōnisasthai moi en tais proseuchais pros ton Theon hyper emou
verses.literal: Now I urge you brothers by our - Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit to join me in my struggle . . . by - praying to - God for me

verses.original: ἵνα ῥυσθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀπειθούντων ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ καὶ μου ἡ διακονία ἡ εἰς Ἰερουσαλὴμ γένηται εὐπρόσδεκτος τοῖς ἁγίοις
verses.transliteration: hina rhysthō apo tōn apeithountōn en tē Ioudaia kai mou hē diakonia hē eis Ierousalēm genētai euprosdektos tois hagiois
verses.literal: [Pray] that I may be delivered from the unbelievers in - Judea and [that] my - service - in Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints [there]

verses.original: ἵνα διὰ Θεοῦ θελήματος ἐλθὼν πρὸς ὑμᾶς ἐν χαρᾷ συναναπαύσωμαι ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: hina dia Theou thelēmatos elthōn pros hymas en chara synanapausōmai hymin
verses.literal: so that by God’s will I may come to you with joy and together with you be refreshed . . .

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης μετὰ πάντων ὑμῶν ἀμήν
verses.transliteration: de Ho Theos tēs eirēnēs meta pantōn hymōn amēn
verses.literal: - The God - of peace [be] with all of you Amen
